Maple Court Townhomes, 31 Maple Ct, Redwood City. 3 bed 2.5 bath, 1,380 sqft. $2,360/mo, or $2,310 with 14-month lease. Pets: 2 pets max, 60 lb weight limit per pet, $400 refundable pet deposit, $35 monthly pet rent per pet (pet rent applies to cats and dogs). Fenced yard. Tenant pays PG&E, water/sewer/trash $95 flat monthly. HOA covers landscaping. App fee $50 per adult, deposit equals one month. Near Hoover Elementary. Available now.
